name: Round1 Bowling & Arcade The Maine Mall
description: Round 1 is a family-friendly entertainment venue that offers a vibrant karaoke experience with a wide song selection and a lively atmosphere. It features private rooms, making it ideal for parties or gatherings. The venue is open late, providing ample time for singing, gaming, and socializing. The sound system is praised for its quality, and staff are friendly and accommodating, creating an inviting environment for all ages. Food, drinks, and alcohol are available, making it a great spot for both fun and relaxation after a busy day.
